title: QA Dataset Explosion: A Taxonomy of NLP Resources for Question Answering and Reading Comprehension

bias_targets.methodology: Surveying and categorizing existing monolingual and multilingual QA/RC datasets to highlight the extreme over-representation of English and the scarcity of resources for other languages.

Reviewing and synthesizing literature on dataset artifacts, shortcuts, and spurious correlations to evaluate the discrepancy between targeted reasoning skills and the heuristics models actually learn.
